comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-broker (broker/DEPENDENCIES.md). The closure covers normal and build dependencies; path dependencies on workspace members are not listed. M3-02 adds hmac and sha2 (and writ-kernel by path); versions as reviewed for M1 (M1-07). BSD-3-Clause is approved for subtle 2.6.1 only (owner decision D-033), not as a general licence.

hmac.role: direct runtime (HMAC-SHA256 ingress seals and permits; constant-time verification); default features off

sha2.role: direct runtime (SHA-256 for HMAC); default features off; same version as writ-kernel

subtle.role: transitive (digest `mac` feature, enabled by hmac; constant-time tag comparison); licence BSD-3-Clause approved for this package only (owner D-033); notice in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md

libc.role: transitive (cpufeatures, target-specific: aarch64 Linux and Android only)
